ShortDescription.Value: Visualize the true reach of your city's services and passive auras. Area of Effect provides butter-smooth, real-time radius overlays for your buildings with absolutely zero impact on your frame rate.

Publish.LongDescription:
Area of Effect (AoE) - Real-Time Auras & Influence Visualization Take the guesswork out of city planning. Area of Effect seamlessly renders the exact influence radii and passive auras for your buildings, allowing you to optimize service coverage, land value, and district layouts with perfect precision.
Key Features:
Passive Auras & Service Radii: Instantly see the true radial auras (Well-being) versus standard road-network service ranges the moment you select or place a building.
Native Engine Integration: Built directly into the game's native OverlayRenderSystem for flawless visual integration with the city map, completely bypassing heavy UI layers.
Uncompromising Performance: Designed with extreme optimization. By hooking directly into the native rendering pipeline, this mod runs with virtually zero overhead. Experience butter-smooth overlays that won't cost you a single frame or cause UI thread hitching.
Clean & Unobtrusive: The overlay graphics are crisp, color-coded, and scale perfectly with the game engine's camera without cluttering your screen.
